validity_findings.finding: Client-side filter excludes X-Worker-Pid in addition to frozen EXCLUDED_HEADERS {Date,Server,X-Request-Id}. This deviates narrowly from spec.json excluded set but is disclosed in report.md section 8 and run_experiment.py header comment as instrumentation artifact removal. Without exclusion, gunicorn round-robin pid variance (46041/46042) would inject spurious fingerprint variance on every request via Connection-pid correlation. Raw headers retain X-Worker-Pid for audit recomputation. Impact is conservative (prevents false positive), not a validity failure, but cross-experiment fingerprint string comparability is already broken (report notes lowercasing divergence).

validity_findings.finding: Spec/prereg state sort_keys=True separators=(',',':') but run_experiment.py uses json.dumps(..., sort_keys=True) with default separators (', ', ': '). Intra-experiment recomputation is consistent (0 mismatches) because parent EXP-RUNTIME-35749360317 uses same default; cross-experiment fingerprint string comparison would diverge by one byte of whitespace if separators truly differed. No effect on discrimination within this experiment, but documentation vs code drift should be aligned for future audits.

validity_findings.finding: All 85+ bootstrap 95% CIs are degenerate [1.0,1.0] or [0.0,0.0] with width 0.0 and effective distinct N=1 per state (set size 1 for all sources). Declared deterministic per measurement_validity and correctly not claimed as high-precision. Director mandate asked for non-degenerate CI test under concurrency; concurrency (4 parallel clients, 540 prod observations) did not introduce variance: Connection header constant keep-alive (nginx proxy_http_version 1.1 + proxy_set_header Connection ""), filtered headers byte-identical per state. This discloses environment low-variance ceiling, not measurement_invalid, but means sensitivity gradient beyond ceiling 1.0 remains untested and bootstrap CI provides no inferential precision.

claim_ceiling: C-MEAS-VALID ceiling EXPANDS from localhost Flask/Werkzeug-only EXPERIMENTAL to production-like single-host WSGI (gunicorn 23.0.0 2x sync workers on 127.0.0.1:19860) + nginx 1.24.0 reverse proxy on 127.0.0.1:19851 (proxy_http_version 1.1, proxy_set_header Connection "", proxy_buffering off) EXPERIMENTAL, at deterministic ceiling (full 1.0, body 1.0, status 0.0, headers_no_clen 0.0/1.0) for the tested magnitudes: bodies 31B/70B/117B (A/B/C) with fixed header set (Cache-Control max-age=3600, ETag W/"fixed-aaa-111", Vary Accept-Encoding) and header variants (CC max-age=0,must-revalidate, ETag W/"changed-bbb-222", Set-Cookie session=xyz, Vary +Origin), under 4-client concurrency and cross-worker SQLite WAL visibility (≈7.5ms commit). Holds for HTTP/1.1 plain loopback, Connection keep-alive constant, filtered header keys lowercased, EXCLUDED {Date,Server,X-Request-Id} plus disclosed X-Worker-Pid. Does NOT promote to VALIDATED or PRODUCT_CORE. Bounded ceiling excludes: paid-tier CDN (Cloudflare/Fastly HIT/STALE/SWR), TLS/HTTP2/QUIC, multi-host Redis/distributed session replication, BrowserGym/AgentLab 1280x720 DOM observation (E4 NOT_TESTED), value-magnitude gradient beyond 31/70/117 and 3 header isolations (still at 1.0/0.0 ceiling, degenerate CI effective N=1, no sensitivity ordering), Vary-only isolation, chunked encoding, header folding beyond lowercased sorted normalization.
